patterns: Dominant shape: leader-centre matching (Hazrat Mahal-Lucknow, Kunwar Singh-Arrah, Nana Saheb-Kanpur, Liyaqat Ali-Allahabad); APPSC-G2 2025 asked exactly this.
Odd-one-out 'not associated with 1857' (Bhagat Singh, Zeenat Mahal) recurs.
APPSC likes Bahadur Shah's exile/death at Rangoon, Shah Mal of Baraut (NCERT line), and Hyderabad chronology (Mubariz-ud-Daula, Turrebaz Khan).
Date-matching of start of revolt at centres (Barrackpore 29 Mar, Meerut 10 May, Lucknow 4 June) asked by UPPSC.
App adds suppression chronology and minor heroines; sound but deeper than PYQs.
